title: security: rbac v2 - tighten audit logging + KMS region-pinning support
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Enhances RBAC v2 policy enforcement, expands audit logging to include KMS key usage events, and adds region-pinning controls for KMS-backed encryption to support data residency requirements.
description: Context: Customers in regulated industries require stronger audit trails for key usage, more granular RBAC controls, and the ability to pin KMS operations to specific cloud regions for data residency compliance. This PR unifies three related compliance features under RBAC v2: 1) tighten default role privileges and introduce scoped policies for admin/audit roles, 2) extend audit logging to record KMS operations and metadata (key id, region, requester, action), and 3) add KMS region-pinning controls with transparent fallbacks. Motivation: reduce blast radius for keys, make key access auditable by default, and enable customers to opt into region-bound encryption semantics. Changes: - RBAC: add new policy statements and evaluation paths for keys and audit-log-read permissions; default roles updated to follow least-privilege; policy schema version bumped to v2.1. - Audit logging: emit structured audit events for KMS Create/Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/Rotate operations; include key fingerprint, region, requester_id, request_id, and route metadata. Events are sent to existing audit pipeline with a new event_type "kms_operation". - KMS integrations: add region parameter to KMS provider interface, implement region pinning at call sites, and validate that pinned-region keys cannot be used from mismatched regions unless explicit cross-region-allow flag is set. - Migration: database migration to add key_metadata.region and key_metadata.pinned boolean flag; migration script included and marked reversible. - Tests: unit tests for RBAC policy evaluation, integration tests simulating multi-region KMS flows, and e2e smoke verifying audit events in the audit pipeline. Rollout plan: feature gated behind feature flag "rbac_v2_kms_pinning"; default off for existing tenants. For Dedicated/Private deployments, an operator migration step is documented. Checklist: - [x] RBAC policy updates and validator schema - [x] Audit event emission + pipeline mapping - [x] KMS provider region param + enforcement - [x] DB migration + migration tests - [x] Unit/integration tests - [x] Docs and release notes - [x] Feature-flag gated for gradual rollout Known limitations: cross-region decryption requires explicit operator opt-in; a follow-up PR will add automated key replication guidance. Related: ENG-2345 (RBAC policy consolidation), SUP-982 (customer support request for KMS pinning).
